title: A bijection on balanced words reversing both $\text{des}$ and $\text{maj}$
summary: Balanced words on a finite alphabet are those words in which every letter of the alphabet occurs the same number of times. The notion of descents and major index extends in a natural way to words. It is known that the bivariate generating polynomials for descents and major index over balanced words on the alphabet $[k]$ with $n$ occurrences each is palindromic, but a bijective proof has been missing even for balanced binary words.
